# Third-party files

- `UE4SS_v3.0.1-1164-g5e627997.zip`: unmodified official RE-UE4SS release
  (https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases), SHA256
  `3c72142a383e25e9f9553ac9e4d5677aa572e98cb369cac57200efb2e381e603`. MIT license, included
  inside the archive as `ue4ss/LICENSE`. This is the build that was confirmed working with
  Dead as Disco in October 2026.
- `mod/DeadAsDiscoAP/Scripts/json.lua`: json.lua by rxi (https://github.com/rxi/json.lua),
  MIT license, notice at the top of the file.
